import json, os
from pathlib import Path
from shutil import copyfile
from scraper.jobs.artifacts import contained, response_paths, validate_response, validated
from scraper.spiders.meetscoresonline import MeetScoresOnlineSpider
root = Path("/app/output/mso-cache")
spider = MeetScoresOnlineSpider(mode="full", cache_mode="replay-cache", output_dir="/app/output")
catalog = spider._load_season_catalog()
chronological = list(reversed(catalog["seasons"]))
historical = [season for season in chronological if (root / "seasons" / f"{season}.json").is_file()]
current = [season for season in chronological if season not in historical]
if not historical:
    raise RuntimeError("No historical MSO season listing caches found")
if not current:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected at least one current season requiring a fetch manifest")
historical_spider = MeetScoresOnlineSpider(mode="full", cache_mode="replay-cache", seasons=",".join(historical), output_dir="/app/output")
historical_specs = historical_spider._replay_meet_specs()
path = spider._latest_fetch_manifest_path(current)
if path is None:
    raise RuntimeError("No complete fetch manifest covers current MSO seasons: %s" % ",".join(current))
manifest = validated(path)
if manifest["mode"] != "full":
    raise RuntimeError("Full bootstrap import requires a full current-season fetch manifest")
responses = response_paths(manifest)
for relative in responses:
    validate_response(contained(root, relative))
os.environ["MSO_REPLAY_MANIFEST"] = str(path)
current_spider = MeetScoresOnlineSpider(mode="full", cache_mode="replay-cache", seasons=",".join(current), output_dir="/app/output")
current_specs = current_spider._replay_meet_specs()
Path("/tmp/historical-seasons.txt").write_text(",".join(historical), encoding="utf-8")
Path("/tmp/current-seasons.txt").write_text(",".join(current), encoding="utf-8")
copyfile(path, "/tmp/mso-current-fetch.json")
Path("/tmp/mso-import-plan.json").write_text(json.dumps({"historical_seasons": historical, "current_seasons": current, "historical_specs": len(historical_specs), "current_specs": len(current_specs), "current_manifest": path.name}, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")
print("Cache preflight passed: historical_seasons=%s historical_specs=%s current_seasons=%s current_specs=%s current_manifest=%s" % (len(historical), len(historical_specs), len(current), len(current_specs), path.name))

set -o nounset
set -o errexit

POSTGRES_PORT=${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}
POSTGRES_EXTRA_OPTS=${POSTGRES_EXTRA_OPTS:-""}
COMPRESS=${COMPRESS:-false}
VERIFY_COMPRESSION=${VERIFY_COMPRESSION:-false}

POSTGRES_DBS=$(echo "${POSTGRES_DB}" | tr , " ")

export PGUSER="${POSTGRES_USER}"
export PGPASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}"
export PGHOST="${POSTGRES_HOST}"
export PGPORT="${POSTGRES_PORT}"

for DB in ${POSTGRES_DBS}; do
  BACKUP_FILENAME=${DB}-$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
  BACKUP_PATH=${BACKUP_FILENAME}.sql

  echo "Backup $DB"

  # Dump database
  pg_dump -d ${DB} ${POSTGRES_EXTRA_OPTS} > ${BACKUP_PATH}

  # Check for errors
  if [ $? != 0 ] ; then
      echo "Failed to backup $DB"
      exit 1;
  fi

  if [ ${COMPRESS} == true ]; then
      gzip -9 ${BACKUP_PATH}

      # Change file extension since we have compressed it
      BACKUP_PATH=${BACKUP_PATH}.gz
  fi

  # Verify compression
  if [[ ${COMPRESS} == true && ${VERIFY_COMPRESSION} == true ]]; then
    gunzip -c ${BACKUP_PATH} > ${BACKUP_FILENAME}.sql

    if [ $? != 0 ] ; then
      echo "Failed to decompress backup"
      exit 1;
    fi

    rm ${BACKUP_FILENAME}.sql
  fi
done
